summary: Hiker slipped while crossing a snowfield on the Southwest Slopes route of Mount Massive and slid about 600 feet; Lake County Search and Rescue hiked roughly four miles to the subject, made contact at about 12,300 feet with a Classic Air Medical helicopter on standby overhead, and walked the injured hiker out of the mountain.
notes: Added run 174, Lake/Park/Teller chunk; article published 2024-06-24 cites Lake County SAR social-media post as original report.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Mount Massive)
